text: Have you heard about the Paddy Power or Betfair data breach? Names, contact details, even betting history might have been exposed. Scammers love this kind of leak. You could get something like fake texts, emails pretending to be from your bank, or even surprise bets on your account. So here's what to do now. Go ahead and change your password, turn on 2FA, ignore sketchy links, and watch your account like a hawk. And if anything looks off, report it fast. If your data was exposed, you could be owed compensation. No win, no fee, and you can check if you're eligible on our website linked in our bio. And whilst you're at it, go ahead and share it with your friends.
